blocks.name: control_unit
blocks.responsibility: Decode opcode, funct3, and funct7 fields to produce all control signals: ALU operation selector, ALU source mux select, memory read/write enable, memory width, register write enable, memory-to-register select, branch/jump/jump-register enables, and immediate type selector.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizing decode in a single combinational block minimizes wiring complexity at the top level and makes the control truth table easy to verify against the ISA specification. A 4-bit alu_op encoding covers all 11 ALU operations with spare encodings for future extension.

blocks.name: alu
blocks.responsibility: Perform the selected arithmetic or logic operation on two 32-bit operands and produce a result plus a zero flag used for branch decisions.
blocks.design_rationale: A pure combinational ALU with a single operation selector keeps the critical path short for single-cycle operation. The zero flag is generated internally to avoid an extra comparator at the top level.

blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Store 32 general-purpose registers with two asynchronous read ports and one synchronous write port. Register x0 always reads as zero and ignores writes.
blocks.design_rationale: Asynchronous read ports are required for single-cycle operation so that register data is available combinationally within the same cycle. The x0 guard is implemented as a simple address check, avoiding a separate mux on the read path.

blocks.name: imm_gen
blocks.responsibility: Extract and sign-extend the immediate field from the instruction word according to the selected immediate type (I, S, B, U, or J).
blocks.design_rationale: Isolating immediate generation into a dedicated block keeps the top-level wiring clean and allows independent verification of each immediate format against the ISA bit-mapping table. A 3-bit selector covers all five types with spare encodings.

blocks.name: pc_next
blocks.responsibility: Compute the next program counter value based on jump, jump-register, branch-taken, or sequential increment. Evaluates branch conditions (beq, bne, blt, bge, bltu, bgeu) using register operands and funct3.
blocks.design_rationale: Encapsulating next-PC logic with branch condition evaluation in one block makes the priority chain (jump > jump_reg > branch > pc+4) explicit and easy to audit. The branch comparison logic is kept here rather than in the ALU to avoid overloading the ALU with signed/unsigned comparison modes.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Top-level single-cycle RV32I CPU. Instantiates control_unit, alu, register_file, imm_gen, and pc_next. Maintains the PC register, drives the instruction and data bus ports, and wires all internal blocks together.
blocks.design_rationale: The top level is kept minimal: it only holds the PC register, instantiates sub-blocks, and performs the load-extension mux and ALU operand mux. This separation ensures each sub-block is independently testable and the top-level wiring is straightforward to review against the bus contract.

notes: Single-cycle design: all sub-blocks are combinational except register_file (synchronous write) and the PC register in cpu. The load-extension logic (selecting byte/halfword/word from data_read_data and applying sign or zero extension) is placed in the cpu top level as a small mux driven by mem_width and funct3, keeping it close to the bus interface. The ALU operand mux (rs2 vs immediate) is also in the top level, controlled by alu_src from control_unit.

instructions.description: Load upper immediate: rd = instr[31:12] << 12
Add upper immediate to PC: rd = pc + (instr[31:12] << 12)
Jump and link: rd = pc + 4, pc = pc + J-type immediate
Jump and link register: rd = pc + 4, pc = (rs1 + I) & 0xFFFFFFFE
Branch if equal: if rs1 == rs2 then pc = pc + B-type immediate
Branch if not equal: if rs1 != rs2 then pc = pc + B-type immediate
Branch if less than (signed): if signed(rs1) < signed(rs2) then pc = pc + B-type immediate
Branch if greater or equal (signed): if signed(rs1) >= signed(rs2) then pc = pc + B-type immediate
Branch if less than (unsigned): if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(rs2) then pc = pc + B-type immediate
Branch if greater or equal (unsigned): if unsigned(rs1) >= unsigned(rs2) then pc = pc + B-type immediate
Load byte: rd = sign_extend(mem8[rs1 + I])
Load halfword: rd = sign_extend(mem16[rs1 + I])
Load word: rd = mem32[rs1 + I]
Load byte unsigned: rd = zero_extend(mem8[rs1 + I])
Load halfword unsigned: rd = zero_extend(mem16[rs1 + I])
Store byte: mem8[rs1 + S] = rs2[7:0]
Store halfword: mem16[rs1 + S] = rs2[15:0]
Store word: mem32[rs1 + S] = rs2[31:0]
Add immediate: rd = rs1 + sign_extend(instr[31:20])
Set less than immediate (signed): rd = 1 if signed(rs1) < signed(I) else 0
Set less than immediate unsigned: rd = 1 if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(I) else 0
XOR immediate: rd = rs1 XOR sign_extend(instr[31:20])
OR immediate: rd = rs1 OR sign_extend(instr[31:20])
AND immediate: rd = rs1 AND sign_extend(instr[31:20])
Shift left logical immediate: rd = rs1 << instr[24:20]
Shift right logical immediate: rd = rs1 >> instr[24:20] (zero-fill)
Shift right arithmetic immediate: rd = rs1 >> instr[24:20] (sign-fill)
Add: rd = rs1 + rs2
Subtract: rd = rs1 - rs2
Shift left logical: rd = rs1 << rs2[4:0]
Set less than (signed): rd = 1 if signed(rs1) < signed(rs2) else 0
Set less than unsigned: rd = 1 if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(rs2) else 0
XOR: rd = rs1 XOR rs2
Shift right logical: rd = rs1 >> rs2[4:0] (zero-fill)
Shift right arithmetic: rd = rs1 >> rs2[4:0] (sign-fill)
OR: rd = rs1 OR rs2
AND: rd = rs1 AND rs2
